evaluation: paired stochastic policies; cumulative native welfare per initial focal resident; equal-family average; missing post-extinction intervals contribute zero
survival: fraction of episodes with focal alive at decision 8; endogenous fission daughters not included

canary.abort: any illegal/nonfinite/replay failure; survival <75% or paired welfare <80% of pilot final at any evaluation; unexpected throughput/memory growth >2x
canary.rollback: immutable pilot final checkpoints; no overwrite
